verdict.rationale: Floot's homepage says one-click "publish" puts the app online instantly with its own shareable link. The custom-domain docs confirm apps are served from a *.floot.app subdomain by default, and llms.txt describes output as a real, deployed app. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the publish flow itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration that one-click publishing works as claimed.
